description: This is a frontend HTML file for a web-based database viewer interface. It contains layout and styling code along with embedded JavaScript to render and interact with database data, tables, and the interface controls.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Triggers reloading of the database list.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables from a specified database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders tabular data into HTML table.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual table cell content based on its data type.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content.
